Pay the application fee of Rs. 1000/- for General Category candidates or Rs. 500/- for SC/ST and Category-1 candidates (with proof of certificate) through NEFT, RTGS, or Challan to the State Bank of India, India Branch (Account No.: 4188972425, IFSC Code: SBIN0013027).

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications for Guest Lecturer positions in various postgraduate departments and the postgraduate department center at Basavakalyan. The specific department names mentioned in the notification include: Kannada English Urdu Economics Political Science Sociology Social Work Women's Studies Commerce Computer Science Mathematics Chemistry Botany Physics History Post-Graduate Department (Basavakalyan Centre)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The salary is provided according to the rules of Bidar University. The engagement is for the 2026-27 academic year for guest lecturer work corresponding to the workload requirements, covering main campus departments and the post-graduate department center at Basavakalyan.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bidar University Guest Lecturer
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official Bidar University website at https://bidaruniversity.karnataka.gov.in/en. Pay the application fee of Rs. 1000/- for General Category candidates or Rs. 500/- for SC/ST and Category-1 candidates (with proof of certificate) through NEFT, RTGS, or Challan to the State Bank of India, India Branch (Account No.: 4188972425, IFSC Code: SBIN0013027). Attach all educational qualifications, experience details, and attested copies of certificates to the filled application form. Send or submit the completed application in person within the prescribed time limit to The Registrar (Administration), Bidar University, Bidar - Jnana Karanji Halahalli - K, Bidar - 585414, Karnataka.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application form downloaded from the official website NEFT / RTGS / Challan receipt for application fee payment Attested copies of educational qualification documents Attested copies of experience details Caste/category certificate (for SC, ST, and Category-1 applicants claiming fee concession)

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The positions are for guest lecturers working on a contract basis for the 2026-27 academic year, subject to workload availability.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for the application fee concession?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and Category-1 pay a reduced fee of Rs. 500/- provided they attach the relevant category certificate, while General Category candidates pay Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 27-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed NET, SET, or KSET or possess a Ph.D. degree in the relevant postgraduate department subject, meeting UGC norms.

faq.question: Q5. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The Registrar (Administration), Bidar University, Bidar - Jnana Karanji Halahalli - K, Bidar - 585414, Karnataka.
